title: ZipServ: Fast and Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Hardware-Aware Lossless Compression
summary_zh: Lossless weight compression 與 Tensor Core GEMM 的硬體感知協同設計。ZipServ 用固定長度 TCA-TBE 表示法避免 variable-length codec 破壞 SIMT，並用 ZipGEMM 在載入壓縮權重後直接於 Tensor Core register 解壓與計算。模型大小最高降低 30%，kernel 相較 cuBLAS 最高加速 2.21×，端到端相較 vLLM 平均 1.22×。
summary_en: Hardware-aware co-design of lossless weight compression and Tensor Core GEMM. ZipServ uses fixed-length TCA-TBE to avoid variable-length codec divergence, then ZipGEMM decompresses loaded weights directly into Tensor Core registers for computation. It reduces model size by up to 30%, speeds kernels by up to 2.21× over cuBLAS, and improves end-to-end inference by 1.22× on average over vLLM.
